reason: RetailSettlement.amount again rounds each interval before summing, exactly the implementation and cause fixed in #5811.
Bluetooth is enabled and failures are specific to v3 locks, unlike the missing Bluetooth-off check in #2401.
The defect is in the independent WarehouseScanner.service_day implementation, which #5111 explicitly did not patch.
Submission completes before the successful pending autosave, reproducing the submit/autosave race in #2304.
Add-on bills again contain fractional-paisa totals rejected by payment links, matching the money calculation defect in #2222.
A fast completed export omits only the final calendar day, indicating a date-boundary defect rather than #2629's large-export timeout.
BulkRouteImport.height has its own conversion defect and was explicitly outside the WaypointEditor.height fix in #5611.
A late-evening session is assigned to the wrong day after daylight saving ends, matching #618's timezone-rule defect.
The checkout invoice rounds GST per line while the booking charge is correct, exactly matching #3174.
The rain counter wraps at the 16-bit unsigned limit, an overflow defect absent from the fixed bugs.
Excluding the joining day causes a full day's underpayment, unlike #823's floating-point rounding discrepancy.
StationBoard.notice again fails to evict its saved notice on updates, reproducing the exact implementation defect in #5911.
The checkout invoice rounds GST line by line while the booking charge agrees with confirmation, reproducing #3174.
Unpaused 25-fps films drift equally across devices at the characteristic rate, matching #3508's frame-rate conversion defect.
A one-for-one bonus creates apparent extra cost for free shares, matching #3374's failure to adjust the average buy price.
The count wraps after 65,535 because it is stored in a 16-bit unsigned integer, not because a sensor value is missing.
Drift during uninterrupted 25-fps playback on both web and TV matches #3508 rather than the TV-only pause-state defect.
Duplicate executions of the same alarm after reboot match #2143's duplicate scheduling defect.
FleetReservation.claim contains an independent unlocked check/write race outside the explicit scope of #5511.
SpecimenLabel.contact again trims a null optional phone without a guard, the exact defect fixed in #5411.
The report describes a one-for-one bonus and unadjusted cost basis, matching apply_bonus() defect #3374.
PartnerSettlement.amount is a separate unpatched implementation, while the RetailSettlement.amount fix in #5811 still works.
The failing HandoverPacket.day implementation was expressly outside #5711's StationCalendar.day patch.
The rating leak occurs only in recommendations while search filtering works, a different defect from #3518 and the other fixed issues.
Loading entire large videos for thumbnails exhausts memory, unlike #1017's missing-profile null dereference.
Hard-coded dark-mode colors create a contrast defect, unrelated to the printer encoding defect in #1105.
Alerts trigger promptly and only iOS delivery is delayed, indicating a push-delivery issue rather than the fixed overnight processing backlog.
BillComposer.total again rounds charges individually before summing, the exact calculation defect in #5211.
DriverBriefing.notice has an independent stale-cache defect outside the StationBoard.notice patch in #5911.
CourierManifest.contact is an independent implementation excluded from #5411, and the patched SpecimenLabel.contact behaves correctly.
Fractional-paisa totals on add-on bills reproduce #2222's money arithmetic defect and payment-link rejection.
The reported value is approximately 5.3 times 18 twice, matching #2522's duplicated conversion factor in the shared UnitConverter.
The printed glucose value matches applying the factor 18 twice to 5.3, reproducing #2522 in the converter shared by reports.
Accented names become the same characteristic mojibake only in outgoing emails, matching #509's encoding defect.
The payslip excludes the first working day and loses a day's pay, a date-counting defect absent from the fixed list.
The same reminder executes twice following reboot, matching #2143's duplicate alarm recreation.
Price detection is timely and Android delivery works, so the delay is in iOS push delivery rather than #3318's alert-processing backlog.
StationCalendar.day again selects the UTC date without station-zone conversion, exactly the defect fixed in #5711.
AppReservation.claim again separates availability checking from writing without a shared lock, reproducing #5511.
DispatchManifest.service_day again takes the UTC date directly, reproducing the same timezone defect fixed in #5111.
Only recommendation results leak adult titles while search and Browse filter correctly, so none of the fixed defects matches.
A retained late-evening session is assigned to the wrong day after daylight saving ends, matching #618.
Bluetooth is enabled and failures isolate to v3 locks, so the Bluetooth-off check defect in #2401 does not explain them.
Accented names show mojibake in emails while remaining correct in the app, matching #509's outgoing-email encoding defect.
AdjustmentBatch.total independently rounds per charge and was explicitly excluded from the working BillComposer.total patch.
WaypointEditor.height again copies feet directly into metres, exactly reproducing #5611.
CatalogCard.load again retains its title snapshot on title-change events, reproducing #5311.
ReservationSlip.load has an independent cache invalidation defect outside the scope of #5311's CatalogCard.load patch.
The dashboard badge has a hard-coded dark-mode contrast defect, which is not represented among the fixed bugs.
The log shows submit finishing before the pending autosave, reproducing #2304's final-answer race.
A small export completes quickly but excludes the last calendar day, a boundary defect distinct from #2629's timeout.
Whole-video thumbnail generation exhausts memory, a different underlying cause from the fixed deleted-user crash.
